rss: Boots has a new owner: Three ways it could affect you
title: Toy Store Gets New Owner
story: There's a toy store you love, and guess what? It has a new owner! This means the store might have new toys, change how it looks, or even have more sales. It's exciting to see what will happen next!
storyBig: A major toy retailer has been sold to a new owner, which could bring changes in product offerings, store layout, and pricing strategies. Consumers might see more diverse products, new store designs, and potentially better deals.
think: What changes would you like to see at your favorite toy store?
bull: New owners might bring exciting changes and new toys!
bear: The new owner might change things you liked about the store.

rss: Burnham promises to curb non-compete rules in job contracts
title: Toy Company Changes Worker Rules
story: A toy company is changing rules for their workers. Now, workers can explore new ideas and even start new toy projects more easily. It's like having more freedom to play and create!
storyBig: A leading toy company is revising its employment contracts, making it easier for workers to pursue new opportunities. This change allows employees to innovate and potentially start new ventures without previous restrictions.
think: Why is it important for workers to have freedom to explore new ideas?
bull: More freedom can lead to cool new toys and ideas!
bear: Too much freedom might cause some workers to leave.
